Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a contralateral mediastinal shift to the right, which is the classic radiographic appearance of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away; lung collapse would typically cause an ipsilateral shift, and pneumothorax would appear radiolucent.
